# Jerrythepopper 洪立楷 — Photography & 3D Portfolio

> 台北攝影師・3D 創作者，1996 年生於台北。用影像捕捉人文、街頭與空間；曾與 Hasselblad、Leica、Sony、Oppo、Giant 等品牌合作。紀實計畫《輪轉》記錄台北第一果菜批發市場。

## Pages

- [首頁 Home](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/)：作品集總覽，七個系列與工作、關於。
- [Hasselblad 哈蘇](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/hasselblad/)：這兩次與哈蘇合作，我想挑戰更多可能。
- [Portraits 人像](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/portraits/)：喜歡幫朋友們，還有重要的人，記錄他們的樣子。
- [3D](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3d/)：探索攝影與 3D 領域的邊界。
- [Street 街拍](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/street/)：街拍，就是我解讀各座城市的方式。
- [Nature 自然](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/nature/)：我時常被大自然震懾，所以努力記下他們的樣貌。
- [Film 底片](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/film/)：底片的驚喜，在於拍完時常會忘記當下的畫面。
- [Taipei Wholesale Market 果菜市場](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/market/)：輪轉（liàn-tńg）— 台北第一果菜批發市場紀實計畫。
- [Work 工作](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/work/)：品牌合作與商業專案。
- [Add-ons 外掛](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/)：Blender 外掛入口頁。
- [About 關於我](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/about/)：簡介、合作品牌、展覽出版與聯絡方式。

## English (/en/)

> Taipei photographer and 3D artist, born 1996 in Taipei. Every page has an English counterpart under /en/; the Chinese text is the original, and x-default points international visitors to the English pages.

- [Hasselblad](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/hasselblad/): For my two collaborations with Hasselblad, I wanted to push what the camera could do.
- [Portraits](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/portraits/): Pictures of my friends, and the people who matter, the way they are.
- [3D](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/3d/): Exploring the edge between photography and 3D.
- [Street](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/street/): Street photography is how I read a city.
- [Nature](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/nature/): Nature keeps stunning me, so I do my best to keep a record of them.
- [Film](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/film/): The surprise of film is that I often forget the frame by the time it comes back.
- [Taipei Wholesale Market](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/market/): Lian-tng, the turning of wheels: a documentary project inside the Taipei First Wholesale Fruit and Vegetable Market.
- [Home](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/): portfolio overview — seven series plus Work and About.
- [Work](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/work/): Selected brand collaborations and commissioned work.
- [Blender Add-ons](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/3daddon/): entry page for the Blender add-ons below.

## Blender add-ons

- Studio Shapers: Softboxes, grids, snoots, flags and scrims built as real meshes, brightness in stops against your main light, a top map for placing lights, and 14 setups that scale to your subject. [Product page](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/studio-shapers/product/) · [Manual](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/studio-shapers/) · [手冊](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/studio-shapers/zh.html) · [Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/studio-shapers)
- Final Quality Pipeline: Finds how many samples and bounces your scene needs, then builds the denoise for the final render. Temporal Denoise steadies animation frames already on disk. [Product page](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/fqp/product/) · [Manual](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/fqp/) · [手冊](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/3daddon/fqp/zh.html) · [Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/final-quality-pipeline)
- [About](https://www.jerrythepopper.com/en/about/): biography, collaborations, exhibitions and contact.
